Name: Alex's Sprite Edit - Emily (1.6)
Author: Alexsir94
Description:
This mod only alters Emily's Portrait and Character sprite (Summer, Winter and Beach)

[i]There is no support for Seasonal Outfits (mod) as of now.[/i]

Install [with Content Patcher]:
- Find your Stardew Valley folder
﻿On Steam right click Stardew Valley > Manage > Browse Local Files,
in this folder go to > Mods
- Unzip or extract the downloaded folder here
- There should now be a folder named "[CP] Alex's Sprite Edit - Emily" in the Mods folder
- Done!

Install [Manual] [i](No other mod needed)[/i]:
- Unzip or extract the folder after download
- Find your Stardew Valley folder
﻿On Steam right click Stardew Valley > Manage > Browse Local Files,
in this folder go to > Content > Characters/Portraits
- Replace Emily.xnb, Emily_Beach.xnb and Emily_Winter.xnb in corresponding folder with the ones from the download (make a copy of the original .xnb files first if you want to revert the process later).
- Done!

[i]Changelog: v1.3 - Updates some missing pixels.
[i][i]Changelog: v1.6.1 - Alters a few hair pixels.[/i][/i]
[i]Changelog: v1.6.3 - Adds winter sprite and extends beach sprite for 1.6.[/i][/i]
